title.narrative: Apoyo de Emergencia a poblaciones vulnerables afectadas por Coronavirus
Emergency Support Program for vulnerable populations affected by Coronavirus

description.narrative: El objetivo de desarrollo general de este proyecto es contribuir a asegurar niveles mnimos de calidad de vida de las personas vulnerables en Brasil frente a la crisis causada por el COVID-19. El objetivo especfico es apoyar niveles mnimos de ingreso y de empleo de personas afectadas por el coronavirus, en el periodo inmediato y durante la recuperacin.

The general development objective of this project is to contribute to ensuring minimum levels of quality of life for vulnerable persons in Brazil amid the crisis caused by COVID-19. The specific objective is to support minimum income and employment levels for those affected by the coronavirus in the immediate period and during the recovery.
Commitment in 2020-08-06
Disbursement in second quarter of 2021
